### custody.py :: validate_capsule_manifest (line 155)
```python
def validate_capsule_manifest(manifest) -> list:
    """C6 key completeness and types. Returns named errors; [] means the manifest is complete and within budget."""
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        return ["manifest is not an object"]
    errs = []
    for k in ("schema", "capsule_id", "created_at", "source_commits", "tool_identities", "presets", "units", "files",
              "total_bytes", "tar_projected_bytes", "ceiling_bytes", "trim"):
        if k not in manifest:
            errs.append("missing key %s" % k)
    if manifest.get("schema", SCHEMA_CAPSULE) != SCHEMA_CAPSULE:
        errs.append("schema %r != %s" % (manifest.get("schema"), SCHEMA_CAPSULE))
    if "capsule_id" in manifest and not (isinstance(manifest["capsule_id"], str) and CAPSULE_ID_RE.match(manifest["capsule_id"])):
        errs.append("capsule_id %r is not cap1-<12 hex>" % (manifest["capsule_id"],))
    if "created_at" in manifest and not (isinstance(manifest["created_at"], str) and UTC_RE.match(manifest["created_at"])):
        errs.append("created_at %r is not UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ" % (manifest["created_at"],))
    sc = manifest.get("source_commits")
    if "source_commits" in manifest:
        if not (isinstance(sc, dict) and isinstance(sc.get("match_accel"), str) and HEX40.match(sc["match_accel"])
                and isinstance(sc.get("oracle_files"), dict) and isinstance(sc.get("inputs"), dict)):
            errs.append("source_commits must carry match_accel (40 hex), oracle_files and inputs")
    if "tool_identities" in manifest and not (isinstance(manifest["tool_identities"], dict) and manifest["tool_identities"]):
        errs.append("tool_identities is empty or not an object")
    if "presets" in manifest and not isinstance(manifest["presets"], dict):
        errs.append("presets is not an object")
    if "units" in manifest and not isinstance(manifest["units"], list):
        errs.append("units is not a list")
    files = manifest.get("files")
    if "files" in manifest:
        if not isinstance(files, dict):
            errs.append("files is not an object")
        else:
            for rel, e in files.items():
                if not (isinstance(e, dict) and isinstance(e.get("sha256"), str) and HEX64.match(e["sha256"])
                        and isinstance(e.get("size"), int) and not isinstance(e.get("size"), bool) and e["size"] >= 0):
                    errs.append("files[%s] lacks a 64-hex sha256 and an integer size" % rel)
                    break
            if "total_bytes" in manifest and all(isinstance(e, dict) and isinstance(e.get("size"), int) for e in files.values()):
                if manifest["total_bytes"] != sum(e["size"] for e in files.values()):
                    errs.append("total_bytes %r != sum of file sizes" % (manifest["total_bytes"],))
    for k in ("total_bytes", "tar_projected_bytes", "ceiling_bytes"):
        if k in manifest and (not isinstance(manifest[k], int) or isinstance(manifest[k], bool) or manifest[k] < 0):
            errs.append("%s is not a non-negative integer" % k)
    ceiling, proj = manifest.get("ceiling_bytes"), manifest.get("tar_projected_bytes")
    if isinstance(ceiling, int) and ceiling > CAPSULE_CEILING_BYTES:
        errs.append("ceiling_bytes %d is above CAPSULE_CEILING_BYTES %d (the ceiling can only be lowered)" % (ceiling, CAPSULE_CEILING_BYTES))
    if isinstance(ceiling, int) and isinstance(proj, int) and proj > ceiling:
        errs.append("tar_projected_bytes %d exceeds ceiling_bytes %d" % (proj, ceiling))
    if "trim" in manifest:
        trim = manifest["trim"]
        if not isinstance(trim, list) or any(t not in TRIM_VOCABULARY for t in trim) or len(set(trim)) != len(trim):
            errs.append("trim must be a list of distinct values from %s, got %r" % (list(TRIM_VOCABULARY), trim))
    if "targets" in manifest:  # optional (plan 03-01, D-09): a capsule built without --targets-from-donors has none
        targets = manifest["targets"]
        if not isinstance(targets, list):
            errs.append("targets is not a list")
        else:
            bad = [t for t in targets if not (isinstance(t, dict) and set(t) == set(TARGET_KEYS)
                                              and isinstance(files, dict) and t.get("target_obj") in files)]
            if bad:
                errs.append("%d targets lack the keys %s or name a target_obj outside files" % (len(bad), list(TARGET_KEYS)))
            if len(set(t.get("entity") for t in targets if isinstance(t, dict))) != len(targets):
                errs.append("targets repeat an entity")
            counts = manifest.get("counts")
            if isinstance(counts, dict) and counts.get("targets") != len(targets):
                errs.append("counts.targets %r != %d targets" % (counts.get("targets"), len(targets)))
    return errs
```

### custody.py :: verify_manifest (line 144)
```python
def verify_manifest(root, manifest: dict) -> dict:
    """Compare the tree under root with manifest["files"]: missing, extra and mismatched (sha256 or size) relpaths."""
    want = manifest.get("files") or {}
    have = scan_tree(root)
    missing = sorted(set(want) - set(have))
    extra = sorted(set(have) - set(want))
    mismatched = sorted(rel for rel in set(want) & set(have)
                        if have[rel]["sha256"] != want[rel].get("sha256") or have[rel]["size"] != want[rel].get("size"))
    return {"ok": not (missing or extra or mismatched), "missing": missing, "extra": extra, "mismatched": mismatched}
```

### custody.py :: judge_receipt (line 270)
```python
def judge_receipt(receipt, current_capsule, pins, expect=None) -> dict:
    """Turn a returned receipt into OK, INVALID_CUSTODY or STALE_INPUT. Only reads its arguments.

    INVALID_CUSTODY: the receipt cannot be trusted (tool drift, task sha disagreement, wrong resource class, malformed
    identity, a receipt that says so itself, params that differ from what the job record expected).
    STALE_INPUT: the receipt is internally sound but ran against a capsule other than CURRENT_CAPSULE."""
    if not isinstance(receipt, dict):
        return {"verdict": "INVALID_CUSTODY", "reasons": ["receipt is not an object"], "job_verdict": None}
    invalid, stale = [], []
    pr = receipt.get("params_received")
    pr = pr if isinstance(pr, dict) else {}
    if receipt.get("schema") != SCHEMA_RECEIPT:
        invalid.append("receipt schema %r != %s" % (receipt.get("schema"), SCHEMA_RECEIPT))
    if not isinstance(receipt.get("params_received"), dict):
        invalid.append("params_received is absent or not an object")
    if receipt.get("resource_class") != "COMPUTE_JOB":
        invalid.append("resource_class %r != COMPUTE_JOB" % (receipt.get("resource_class"),))
    sc = receipt.get("source_commit")
    if not (isinstance(sc, str) and HEX40.match(sc)):
        invalid.append("source_commit %r is not 40 hex" % (sc,))
    measured = receipt.get("measured") if isinstance(receipt.get("measured"), dict) else {}
    if measured.get("task_sha256") != pr.get("task_sha256"):
        invalid.append("measured.task_sha256 %s != params_received.task_sha256 %s"
                       % (measured.get("task_sha256"), pr.get("task_sha256")))
    tools_check = tools_on_arrival_ok(receipt, pins)
    if not tools_check["ok"]:
        invalid.extend(tools_check["mismatches"])
    cust = receipt.get("custody") if isinstance(receipt.get("custody"), dict) else {}
    reason_codes = (cust.get("reason_code"), receipt.get("reason_code"))
    if "INVALID_CUSTODY" in reason_codes:
        invalid.append("the receipt reports INVALID_CUSTODY itself (%s)" % (cust.get("details") or receipt.get("reason_code")))
    if "STALE_INPUT" in reason_codes:
        stale.append("the receipt reports STALE_INPUT itself (%s)" % (cust.get("details") or receipt.get("reason_code")))

    if expect is not None:
        if not isinstance(expect, dict):
            invalid.append("expect is not an object")
        else:
            for key in PARAM_KEYS:
                if key in expect and pr.get(key) != expect[key]:
                    invalid.append("params_received.%s %r != expected %r" % (key, pr.get(key), expect[key]))

    cid, csha = pr.get("capsule_id"), pr.get("capsule_sha256")
    block = receipt.get("capsule")
    if cid not in (None, "none"):
        if isinstance(block, dict):
            if block.get("capsule_id") != cid or block.get("manifest_sha256") != csha:
                invalid.append("the receipt's capsule block (%s, %s) disagrees with params_received (%s, %s)"
                               % (block.get("capsule_id"), block.get("manifest_sha256"), cid, csha))
            if block.get("files_verified") != block.get("files_total"):
                invalid.append("capsule arrival verified %s of %s files" % (block.get("files_verified"), block.get("files_total")))
        if not isinstance(current_capsule, dict) or not current_capsule.get("capsule_id"):
            stale.append("no CURRENT_CAPSULE to compare capsule %s against" % cid)
        else:
            if cid != current_capsule.get("capsule_id"):
                stale.append("capsule_id %s != CURRENT capsule %s" % (cid, current_capsule.get("capsule_id")))
            if csha != current_capsule.get("manifest_sha256"):
                stale.append("capsule manifest sha256 %s != CURRENT manifest %s" % (csha, current_capsule.get("manifest_sha256")))
    verdict = "INVALID_CUSTODY" if invalid else ("STALE_INPUT" if stale else "OK")
    return {"verdict": verdict, "reasons": invalid + stale, "job_verdict": receipt.get("verdict")}
```

```python
def decomp_registered(registry: str = DECOMP_REGISTRY) -> set:

        return set()
```

### ledger.py :: export (line 139)
```python
def export(out_path: str, current: dict, path: str = None, registry: str = DECOMP_REGISTRY) -> dict:
    """Write the src_registry/1 hand-over. Returns {exported, excluded: {reason: [ids]}}. Refuses on a broken
    ledger: a hand-over built from a tampered chain would launder it into decomp."""
    v = verify(path)
    if not v["ok"]:
        raise A.Refused("EXPORT_REFUSED ledger verify failed: %s" % v["errors"][:3])
    already, chosen, excluded = decomp_registered(registry), {}, {}
    for r in read_rows(path):
        eid = r["entity"]
        if not r.get("promotable"):
            continue
        reason = None
        if eid in already:
            reason = "ALREADY_REGISTERED"
        elif drift(r, current):
            reason = "STALE"
        elif eid in chosen:
            continue                                         # first qualifying row by seq wins
        if reason:
            excluded.setdefault(reason, []).append(eid)
            continue
        chosen[eid] = {"id": eid, "name": r["name"], "origin": "match_accel ledger seq %d (%s/%s)" % (
            r["seq"], r["producer"], r.get("strategy") or "-"), "preset": r["preset"],
            "source_path": r["source_path"], "source_sha256": r["source_sha256"]}
    body = json.dumps({"schema": REGISTRY_SCHEMA, "rows": [chosen[k] for k in sorted(chosen)]}, indent=1,
                      ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out_path)), exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(body)
    return {"exported": len(chosen), "excluded": {k: sorted(set(v)) for k, v in excluded.items()}}
```

### ledger.py :: append (line 53)
```python
def append(row: dict, held: bool = False, path: str = None) -> dict:
    """Append under the worker lease (held=True when the caller already holds it). Refuses a row without an
    oracle verdict or custody fields; a row whose key is already present returns the stored row (idempotent)."""
    missing = [k for k in REQUIRED if row.get(k) in (None, "")]
    if missing:
        raise A.Refused("LEDGER_ROW_REFUSED missing %s" % ",".join(missing))
    if row.get("verdict") not in ("ASM_REFUSED",) and not row.get("compiler_sha256"):
        raise A.Refused("LEDGER_ROW_REFUSED no compiler_sha256 for verdict %s" % row.get("verdict"))
    if not os.path.isfile(row["source_path"]) or A_sha(row["source_path"]) != row["source_sha256"]:
        raise A.Refused("LEDGER_ROW_REFUSED source blob missing or differs")
    lease = None if held else A.Lease(holder="ledger.append").acquire()
    try:
        p = path or ledger_path()
        rows = read_rows(p)                                  # re-read the tip UNDER the lease (compare-and-swap)
        k = row_key(row)
        for r in rows:
            if row_key(r) == k:
                return r
        out = {x: v for x, v in row.items() if x not in CHAIN}
        out["seq"] = rows[-1]["seq"] + 1 if rows else 1
        out["prev_hash"] = rows[-1]["row_hash"] if rows else GENESIS
        out["row_hash"] = row_hash(out)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
        with open(p, "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
            f.write(canon(out) + "\n")
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        return out
    finally:
        if lease:
            lease.release()
```
